# v0.3.19 — Icons instead of words

## What's changed

- Fixed: when an update was available, the update pill took so much room that "Main chat" in the sidebar entry wrapped into a vertical column. The update control is now a single download icon, and the entry's label no longer wraps.
- Small controls use icons instead of words: the update button (download, restart, or a warning when it failed), the notice line under the input (notice, open link, close), the background model button (a layers icon before the model name) and the Topic workspaces entry. Hover any of them for the full text; screen readers read the same text.

Validation: automated tests, type checks and packaging passed.

## 中文

- 修复：有新版本时，更新按钮太宽，把左侧入口里的「主聊天」挤成了竖排。现在更新按钮只是一个下载图标，入口的文字也不会再换行。
- 小按钮改用图标：更新按钮（下载；需要重启时是刷新图标；失败时是警告图标）、输入框下方的公告（公告、打开链接、关闭）、后台模型按钮（模型名前一个图层图标），以及「话题工作区」入口。鼠标悬停可以看到完整说明，读屏软件读出的也是同样的文字。

已通过自动化测试、类型检查和打包。
